notes.title: Doom Eternal's free next-gen update out late June
notes.notes: Doom Eternal's free next-gen update comes out 29th June for Xbox Series X and S and PlayStation 5, Bethesda has announced.This update offers improved visuals, increased performance and support for ray-tracing, or 4K resolution at 60fps, or an optional 120fps mode.The next-gen update is also coming to PC, which adds ray-tracing support on compatible machines.Read more
